evidence.description: needsUpdate obtains the previous news update date directly from User.shared.
save directly updates User.shared.news after writing the news data.

candidates.explanation: News directly reads and updates shared user state through User.shared to determine update timing and record a successful save. This operational dependency is hard-coded rather than supplied through an explicit, replaceable boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The state getter reads and sorts items; dispatch is a separate utility queue.
The mutable items property's observer schedules a main-queue closure that reads state, which in turn reads items.
The network completion schedules work on the utility queue that reads and replaces items.
restore also mutates items from the utility queue.

candidates.explanation: The mutable items property is written on the private utility dispatch queue but read through state on the main queue. Serializing background mutations does not protect reads performed on a different queue, and no actor isolation or synchronization covers both access paths.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
